involved_tools.name: get-forecast
involved_tools.description:
Get a weather forecast for a location, optionally including detailed forecast lines.

Usage rules:
- Provide latitude and longitude; latitude must be between -90 and 90, and longitude between -180 and 180.
- Optionally set periods to a positive integer to limit the maximum number of forecast periods returned.
- Optionally set includeDetails to a boolean to request detailed lines such as wind information.
- Do not include parameters other than latitude, longitude, periods, and includeDetails.

includeDetails.description: Whether to include detailed lines such as wind information

periods.description: Maximum number of forecast periods to return

involved_tools.name: create_project
involved_tools.description:
Creates a project with a name and description, optionally associating a repository URL and categorization tags.

Usage rules:
- Provide workingDirectory as an existing, accessible absolute path; relative paths are not valid. When the server runs with --claude, this parameter is ignored in favor of a global user directory.
- Provide both name and description. repoUrl and tags are optional.

description.description: A detailed description of the project

name.description: The name of the new project

repoUrl.description: Optional repository URL associated with the project

tags.description: Optional tags for categorizing the project

workingDirectory.description: The full absolute path to the working directory where data is stored. MUST be an absolute path, never relative. Windows: "C:\Users\username\project" or "D:\projects\my-app". Unix/Linux/macOS: "/home/username/project" or "/Users/username/project". Do NOT use: ".", "..", "~", "./folder", "../folder" or any relative paths. Ensure the path exists and is accessible before calling this tool. NOTE: When server is started with --claude flag, this parameter is ignored and a global user directory is used instead.

involved_tools.name: create_task
involved_tools.description:
Creates a task in a project, with optional status, priority, complexity, estimate, dependencies, tags, and parent-task placement.

Usage rules:
- Provide workingDirectory as an existing, accessible absolute path; relative paths are not valid. When the server runs with --claude, this parameter is ignored in favor of a global user directory.
- Provide name, details, and projectId. Other fields are optional; status defaults to pending.
- priority and complexity, when supplied, must be from 1 to 10. estimatedHours must be nonnegative. Use parentId to place the task under a parent; omit it for a top-level task.

complexity.description: Estimated complexity/effort (1-10, where 10 is most complex)

dependsOn.description: Array of task IDs that must be completed before this task

details.description: Detailed description of what the task involves

estimatedHours.description: Estimated time to complete in hours

name.description: The name/title of the new task

parentId.description: Parent task ID for unlimited nesting (optional - creates top-level task if not specified)

priority.description: Task priority level (1-10, where 10 is highest priority)

projectId.description: The ID of the project this task belongs to

workingDirectory.description: The full absolute path to the working directory where data is stored. MUST be an absolute path, never relative.
